items.title: Cosimo Matassa Interview, 1994-01-15
items.q: except for Al Young who used to come regularly and fall drunk into the front door. And I'd have to, you know, take him around and get him coffee and get him sober and bring him home.

ctx.x: Let me preface all of this by saying that I made an immense effort over all my time in the music business not to become part and parcel of the music scene. I kept my kids and my wife separate from that. And I did because I felt I could deal with some of the people that I dealt with and maybe not be scarred too badly. But I didn't want them to have to. And so I kept that, my family life, really separate. There were maybe three people in the whole business that ever came to my house, you know, and that kind of…
Did you, in a sense, try to keep your, and sometimes keep yourself at a distance from the record company people in that the musicians, artists, people would lump you in?
